name: Conrad Bali
insider_take: This beachfront sanctuary sits on Tanjung Benoa's pristine white sands, where traditional Balinese architecture meets contemporary luxury in perfect harmony.
whats_special: Conrad Bali is built on a former turtle nesting ground and maintains its commitment to marine conservation through their turtle protection program. The resort features the largest lagoon-style swimming pool in Southeast Asia, spanning over 350 meters with six interconnected pools that wind through lush tropical gardens.
pro_tip: Book a beachfront suite on the upper floors for unobstructed sunrise views over the Indian Ocean, and time your stay during turtle season (April-September) to witness baby turtle releases.
dont_miss: The resort's exclusive access to Tanjung Benoa Beach offers some of Bali's calmest waters, perfect for water sports. Visit the on-site Jiwa Spa, built over lily ponds with treatment rooms featuring glass floors for a truly unique wellness experience overlooking the lagoon.
pros: Stunning beachfront location with pristine white sand beach
Exceptional spa facilities with traditional Balinese treatments
Multiple award-winning restaurants with diverse cuisine options
Luxurious infinity pools overlooking the Indian Ocean
cons: Large resort property may feel less intimate
